_about: URLs that `npm run docs:links` (scripts/docs-links.mjs) does not check as written, each with its reason. An entry that matches no URL in the repository fails the run.

skip.http://localhost:8080: Example address of a self-hosted registry in the --registry-url example of docs/commands.md.
skip.http://192.0.2.1/never: TEST-NET-1 address (RFC 5737), used in the release smoke test because it does not route.

https://api.oa2a.org.reason: Registry API base, printed as the --registry-url default. Its root answers 404, so its health endpoint is checked.

https://pypi.org/pypi.reason: PyPI JSON API base; the CLI requests <base>/<name>/json, checked here with the name pip.

https://pypi.org/pypi/.reason: The start of the template https://pypi.org/pypi/<name>/json in the changelog, checked with the name pip.

https://discord.gg/uRZa3KXgEn.reason: An invite link with a made-up code answers 200 too. Discord's invite API answers 404 for one.

catchAll.img.shields.io: Badge images: a made-up badge path answers 200 too, so only the status of the badge URL itself is checked.
catchAll.pypi.org: A made-up path under a project, such as pypi.org/pypi/pip/<made-up>, redirects to a project page that answers 200, so only the status of the URL itself is checked.
